sections.Profile:
The "Sportsman" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on February 11, 1952, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Hunting, Animals
